patch.description: Qualify one rights-reviewed industrial CAD receiver/profile with representative import/export/round trips across all seven recipes/options/grades. Preserve fixed 0.001 cm geometry, units, piece/grade identity and relations, seams/marks/grainlines, malformed-input rejection, repeatability, readable rendered output, legacy DXF and protected identities. S668 DGS ASTM/AAMA import of approved /2 candidate returned a blank canvas and 0/0 patterns; candidate retired. S669 performs one local DGS sample/native positive-control roundtrip to identify whether a receiver-native profile route exists. This cannot pass product acceptance or establish standards conformance. Keep all gates and holds.
